reference.text: Shifting the barrow from my hand to his, he told me a funny story about the first wheelbarrow he had ever seen.

We borrowed a wheelbarrow, and embarking our things, including my own poor carpet-bag, and Queequeg’s canvas sack and hammock, away we went down to “the Moss,” the little Nantucket packet schooner moored at the wharf.

underlines.text: Don’t you know you might have killed that chap

reference.text: “Why,” said I, “Queequeg, you might have known better than that, one would think.
Hoisting sail, it glided down the Acushnet river.
